title: Structure Set
description: Defines a structure set that controls the placement and distribution of structures in the world. A Structure Set contains a set of Jigsaw Structures and rules for how those structures should be placed in the world relative to other instances of structures from the same set. Each structure within a set is paired with a weight that influences how frequently it is chosen.

tokens.text: controls structure placement and distribution in the world

fields.title: Format Version
fields.description: The format version of this structure set definition.

fields.title: Description
fields.description: The description block containing the structure set identifier.

fields.title: Placement
fields.description: Defines how structures in this set are placed in the world.

fields.title: Type
fields.description: The placement algorithm type. Valid values: 'minecraft:random_spread', 'minecraft:concentric_rings'.

fields.title: Salt
fields.description: Seed used for the random generator to provide a unique scatter pattern. This is used to prevent overlap when multiple structure sets share the same placement values.

fields.title: Separation
fields.description: Padding (in chunks) within each grid cell. Structures will not generate within the padded area.

fields.title: Spacing
fields.description: Grid cell size (in chunks) used when generating the structure. Structures will attempt to generate at a random position within each cell. Must be greater than separation.

fields.title: Spread Type
fields.description: How structures spread within the grid. Valid values: 'linear', 'triangular'.

fields.title: Structures
fields.description: Array of structures in this set with their relative weights.
